hero_heading: Life Is Complicated. At Least We Can Laugh About It.
hero_intro: Two fictional audio comedies about the ridiculous things we do at work, at home, and with the people who matter most. Quick conversations. Familiar disasters. Unexpected insights.
hero_cadence: Two new five-minute episodes every week — one about business, one about life and relationships.

shows.title: Business Unusual
shows.description: Max Logic has a system for everything. Marsha Chaos has a question that ruins it. Together, they tackle the wonderfully messy reality of owning a business — with the occasional expert who makes things even more interesting.
shows.status_note: Individual show archive and episode pages pending pilot audio & RSS feed setup.

shows.title: Mr. Right & Mrs. Maybe
shows.tagline: He Has All the Answers. She Has All the Questions.
shows.description: A couple with two opinions about absolutely everything: love, work, family, money, plans and the mysterious rules of living together. Sometimes he is right. Sometimes she is. Sometimes the dishwasher wins.
shows.status_note: Individual show archive and episode pages pending pilot audio & RSS feed setup.

bridge_heading: Same Problems. Different Sides of the Story.
bridge_body: A business owner says nobody takes responsibility. An employee says nobody lets them. At home, the same argument may be happening over dinner. Different lives. Familiar patterns. Plenty to laugh about.
archive_note: 40 initial episode topics (20 weeks) are planned in docs/podcast-handoff/02_CREATIVE_AND_CONTENT/EPISODE_SLATE_40.csv. Only published episodes will appear publicly once podcast hosting, RSS feeds, and pilot audio are connected.
subscribe_body: Get the latest episode in your inbox, or follow the shows wherever you listen to podcasts.
subscribe_note: Newsletter signup and podcast directory badges (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, RSS) will be activated once the podcast host and email provider are connected.
cta_p1: Sometimes we laugh because the alternative is to cry.
cta_p2: But what if you could laugh about your problems because they're finally behind you?
cta_p3_rest: Discover what's keeping you stuck, find a way forward, and turn today's worries into tomorrow's funny stories.
cta_p4: Not because you've learned to live with the problems — but because you've actually resolved them.
cta_sub: A personal conversation, not another podcast episode.
